notes:
Non-bibs won it 8-3, and it was not close. Simon Stears dictated and organised the whole game for the non-bibs: they kept the ball, held their shape and everyone around him played better for it. The bibs never got organised.

The classic reversal on top of that. The non-bibs' weakest players had their best games - John Bassil played at 4 or 5 and got a couple of goals, Ryan Cooper played well above a 4. The bibs' best players went the other way: Harry Felmingham was off it, Lee Kent's head dropped once the game got away, Nathan Herbertson was steady but no more. Every non-bibs player hit their rating or beat it.

A perfect storm rather than a bad split on paper - 61 v 60. Two takeaways for future picks: formation and getting players into the right positions matters a lot at 9v9, and having an organiser like Simon on a side lifts everyone around him. The balancer needs to weight footballing brain more heavily than it does. Scorers not recorded.
